description: This file is a performance testing framework for Git, intended to be sourced by performance test scripts rather than executed directly. It sets up environment variables, repositories, and utilities to measure performance of Git operations, including functions for creating repositories, running timed tests, and handling test environments.

methods.name: die_if_build_dir_not_repo
methods.description: Checks if the build directory is a Git repository; exits if not.

methods.name: test_perf_create_repo_from
methods.description: Creates a new repository by copying an existing one, with options for symlink handling.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Creates a large repository based on the large repo path.

methods.name: test_checkout_worktree
methods.description: Checks out all files in the index.

methods.name: test_run_perf_
methods.description: Runs a performance test with timing, environment setup, and cleanup.

methods.name: test_wrapper_
methods.description: Wraps a test with prerequisites, setup, and result collection.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Main function to run a performance test with multiple repetitions.
